name: IC 3430 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3430, a dwarf elliptical galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ic3430-hubble
story: IC 3430 is a small dwarf elliptical galaxy with little gas left for making new stars. Yet its core holds hot, massive stars, likely sparked by ram pressure as the galaxy plows through the gas of the Virgo Cluster.

claims.text: IC 3430 is a dwarf elliptical (dE) galaxy
IC 3430 is part of the Virgo cluster
IC 3430 has little gas to form new stars
IC 3430's core holds hot, massive stars, likely triggered by ram pressure as it moves through the Virgo cluster's gas
Hubble program 17240 imaged 11 Virgo cluster dwarf galaxies undergoing ram pressure stripping, IC 3430 among them
